Riverlane and NVIDIA have partnered to accelerate the calibration of quantum error‑correction (QEC) decoders using GPU processing, dramatically reducing the time required for these critical tasks in fault‑tolerant quantum computing. By leveraging high‑performance GPUs, the collaboration accelerates data‑driven tuning algorithms that optimize QEC code performance on emerging quantum processors. This development, reported through worldwide news aggregators such as Google News, highlights a significant step toward scalable and efficient error correction for practical quantum systems.
